meta.display: The Sarrow Vale — the province pack v0.1 (world-2 L2, slices 1-2)
meta.notes: world-2 level 2 (iter-118/119): a fantasy province at pack scale — authored pillars over a generated surface (phases.md §6, D-130's sketch; the Qud split). ORIGINAL nouns (the posture tier: the repo's public 2nd setting is original — D-015/REFERENCES §10; the level-1 reskin instrument was the OPEN generic stack, this is not). The skeleton slice (iter-118): the 324-site map, the river-artery lattice, the settlements, the cast WITH spine records (the AP crosswalk's first consumer — D-148/D-152: the first pack to carry spine records gets them lint-checked), the T1 twin. The cultures slice (iter-119): the two name-1 phonotactic profiles (lowland soft vs hill hard — name-1's first committed arming, D-131/D-153), the condensation travelers (the road-traffic group with generated_name members, the reachability law riding condense_event), the custom vocabularies + prohibition sets (the cultures block, belief-as-rules data). The factions triangle, the deep feud history and the calendar are the follow-up slices (the wave plan, TASKS world-2). Every value is pack data, never code (INV-3).

locations.name: the Sarrow road
locations.role: the travel spine: journeys start and land here
locations.notes: the valley road between the weir stair and the half-pay keep — the artery's own spine (the road_pack's loc_street shape, the hub the player starts on); open ground, no sight lines into interiors

locations.name: the weir stair
locations.role: the crossing: the Sarrow leaves the hills here, the toll is taken
locations.notes: Ketta's weir — the road crosses the Sarrow by the stair; the boathouse timbers the only burnable thing on the bank (the flood took the rest)

locations.name: the half-pay keep
locations.role: the garrison post: the levy road passes the gate; the relief's rest post
locations.notes: the under-paid garrison on the shoulder above Malby — the watch pair swaps between this rest post and the market duty post (crime_watch.rotation); the hearth the only lit fire in the province's interiors

locations.name: Malby, the market town
locations.role: the wealth node: the weighbeam, the stalls, the rumor scene (mandatory: this is where hearsay lives)
locations.notes: the bank market on the navigable Sarrow — the seed settlement's continuity (the v0.1 tavern/street/market cluster grown into a town, D-130's polygon); the duty post of the watch pair, the crowd listener lives here; the stall row the market's fire exposure

locations.name: the smelt crofts
locations.role: the iron: the hill folk's bloom fires behind the keep
locations.notes: Garrick's camp — the charcoal stacks are the province's worst fire trap (the smelting camp is a standing hazard by design, mid-grim); the estranged half of the province (the cultures row's hill folk — name-1 profiles ride the follow-up slice)

locations.name: Thornmill, the tithe manor
locations.role: the old families' seat: the burned mill, the grief, the tithe barn (the arson target)
locations.notes: the old family's seat — the feud's fire took the mill a generation back (the worldgen chronicle owns the story, the collections: feud/quarrel); the tithe barn the present arson target; unlit — the burned mill stays dark (the acquisition's night-fidelity step, the road's unlit-open-ground law)

npcs.name: the factor's runner
npcs.role: a downstream trading house's errand-audit up-country
npcs.goal: audit the convoy debts, be home before the rains
npcs.notes: starts on the artery and walks the province (the smoke script's own walk); crime_status is the crime_watch convention (rules.json crime_watch.status_values); carries the house waybill book (the manifest-check family's target — the document_check demand reads it)

npcs.name: Ketta
npcs.role: the weir keeper, toll-taker of the crossing

spine.flaw: the crossing answers the heaviest purse
spine.cause: the flood year drowned the family punt and the savings with it

npcs.notes: the crossing's toll-keeper — the spine's flaw rides the coerce urgency entry (AP-8's consuming rule: the double toll when a rich-seeming traveler crosses); the punt pole the family's last tool (items)

npcs.name: Dellan
npcs.role: the crossing's second hand, the rope side of the pole
npcs.goal: walk the crossing's road side; the paper that prices it watched for the family

spine.want: the crossing worked — one on the water, one on the rope
spine.need: the punt bought back before the next flood year
spine.flaw: the rope side answered the road, not the stair
spine.cause: the flood year drowned the family punt and the savings with it

npcs.notes: the crossing household's grown second hand — ANCHOR_REGION §6.1's first meso unit, the pack embodiment §9 names the engineering side's own (companion-1 + tune-3's arming, iter-157): the pole is two-handed work, one on the water (Ketta's stair), one on the rope (this hand's road leg — the road-side urgency entry IS the rope side's beat). The pair map: kin trust with the toll-taker, a working acquaintance with the runner (the crossing vouches for the road). The spine shares the household's flood cause; the flaw is the road-leg beat's own bend (AP-8: the entry's flaw key consumes it). The no-teleport law: every leg an ordinary move intent through the door — the autonomous road-leg hop when co-located, the paired mode B steps beyond it; lag is a legal world state.

npcs.name: Osgar
npcs.role: the half-pay watch sergeant, duty post at Malby

spine.flaw: the levy bends for whoever feeds it
spine.cause: the crown's quartermaster shorted the garrison two winters running

npcs.notes: the duty holder at the market post (the rotation's outgoing; pickpocket target — the pay tin is thin this season, the expectations rule's item); the spine's flaw rides the manifest-demand urgency entry (AP-8: the fed levy leans on strangers' papers)

npcs.name: Ferra
npcs.notes: receives Osgar's knowledge at watch change (transfer event); pair trust 75 — colleagues (P2a, D-020); the pair.pc_01.suspicion home (suspectaxis-2, D-102); the manifest-check relief hook's target (the document-check family's second arm)

npcs.name: Maren
npcs.role: Malby's market mistress, keeper of the weighbeam

spine.flaw: the scales tilt for old coin
spine.cause: the feud burned her mother's stall and the family credit never recovered

npcs.notes: the wealth node's voice — the spine's flaw rides the talk urgency entry (AP-8: the well-reputed stranger gets her small talk, the scales tilt for old coin); the storm murmur hook's target (weather-1's seeded consequence, the market watching the rain eat the stalls)

npcs.name: Garrick

spine.flaw: the iron hides when prices fall
spine.cause: the guild factor shaved the weight two seasons back and the camp starved

npcs.notes: the hill folk's voice at the iron camp — the spine's flaw rides the linger urgency entry (AP-8: the bloom held back when the price turns); the charcoal sack is his camp's (items)

npcs.name: Wilmot
npcs.role: Thornmill's steward, keeper of a burned name

spine.cause: the feud's fire took the mill and the young heir together

npcs.notes: the old families' voice — the spine's flaw rides the ramble urgency entry (AP-8: the grief-ramble to no one in particular, the drunk's ambient shape re-voiced mid-grim); intoxication 30 — the grey-brew (the jug, items) feeds his witness quality (the §6 intersection matrix)

npcs.role: a lowland drover, the herd road to the bank market
npcs.goal: reach the bank market before the stalls close
npcs.notes: the condensation travelers (the cultures slice, D-153's wave plan): the road traffic's lowland arm — an UNBORN name on the artery, drawn from the lowland_soft profile at the condensation (name-1's first committed arming, D-131; the lazy-depth law: unnamed until the reader's zone warms). No spine, no urgency — the stranger is the population tier until the first beat materializes the group (depth-7, the inn's-strangers shape at province scale)

npcs.role: a lowland peddler, the pack on the shoulder
npcs.goal: walk the artery before the rains close it
npcs.notes: the road traffic's second lowland stranger — the traveling trade the guild's shelter law answers to (the cultures block's prohibition rides the lowland record); the unborn name rides the same condensation, its own name stream (the D-079 family law: one stream per declaration, no cross-talk)

npcs.role: a hill carrier, the crofts' man on the artery
npcs.goal: walk the bloom to the bank; the wergeld stays named
npcs.notes: the road traffic's hill arm — the crofts' own tongue on the artery (hill_hard, the clipped hard profile); the goal carries the wergeld word (the hills' prohibition made live on the road, the hill vocabulary's own token); the estranged half of the valley walking beside the lowland pair — one artery, two tongues

ambient_entities.name: the market queue
ambient_entities.notes: passive knowledge-holder and rumor listener (MVP_SCOPE §4.2): the bank crowd at the weighbeam — no goals, no relations, no movement — receives knowledge records only

items.name: the tallow lamp
items.notes: fire source; breakable — the drop_break target that starts the arson chain on the road (the runner's own lamp, the §3 walkthrough shape)

items.name: the garrison pay tin
items.notes: Osgar's levy tin, thin this season — the steal target; the expectations rule's item (the inferred-tin-missing ladder's anchor)

items.name: the jug of grey-brew
items.notes: the steward's grief-brew — the intoxication vector feeding Wilmot's witness quality (the road's mead-jug shape, re-voiced)

items.name: the tally staff
items.notes: Maren's market staff, beside the weighbeam (the cudgel analog — the keep-peace of the market town)

items.name: the charcoal sack
items.notes: the crofts' utility sack, by the stacks — the flammable prop at the camp (the road's hawser shape)

items.name: the punt pole
items.notes: the family's last tool (KI#87's fix: the weirkeeper's note cited it, the items never carried it — committed with the household's second hand, the pack's next engineering touch): the pole is two-handed work — the second hand walks the rope side with it, and the punt it once pushed drowned the flood year (ANCHOR_REGION §6.1's assets: the boathouse, the pole, the custom). Carried: the position contract rides every leg the second hand walks (movement_changes, KI#46's law). iter-161 (the pole's embodiment seeds): the steal_target flag is the verb-gate boundary's unless-arm (WORLD_AUTHORING §8 — carried ⇒ unstealable UNLESS the pack flags it): the pole is liftable unseen from the second hand's shoulder, the player-facing ablation's own gate (the carrier-ablation probe's flagged-theft arm, WORLD_TESTS §7). The flag opens exactly one gate — take stays uncarried-gated, drop_break stays the carrier's own; a successful lift flips the carrier binding to the thief and the road-leg beat then walks the second hand pole-less (the tool's availability a lawful world state).

groups.name: the road traffic
groups.notes: the condensation travelers (depth-7's first committed arming, the cultures slice): the artery's traffic as ONE group entity — the population tier while cold (road_counts, the cardinality aggregate at the macro crossings), the named strangers when the reader's zone warms (road_musters, the members' canon member_of births + their drawn names). Anchored ON the road the runner starts at: the group is active at the first zone computation and condenses immediately — the PC walks into a materialized world (the DF precedent, the load-state origin law). The members: two lowland tongues and one hill tongue — name-1's profiles consumed by the condensation's own draw

groups.name: the river guild
groups.notes: the trade's twin posts (slice 3, the triangle's first arm): the market mistress and the crossing keeper — the weighbeam and the weir, the river trade acting as ONE group entity through the intent door (depth-6's first committed arming, D-112's one-id law). The guild's pressure axis is fear: the trade flinches at danger sooner than any power in the vale (trigger 30, the lowest bar). The cultures block's shelter law is this guild's own declared limit (slice 2, D-154).

groups.name: the old families
groups.notes: the feud's two houses (the triangle's second arm): the manor's steward and the crofts' smelter-master — the mill that burned and the bloom that never forgot the blood price. Their pressure axis is grievance, the wergeld's own axis (decay 0 — a man-price once named stays named until paid, the hills' prohibition law). The threshold is 50: with two members, the old blood moves only when BOTH houses grieve — the families' deliberate deadband.

groups.name: the half-pay garrison
groups.notes: the crown's shorted watch (the triangle's third arm): the market-post sergeant and the keep's corporal — the rotation pair (crime_watch's own participants), reading the same fear axis as the guild at the trained bar (trigger 50): the merchants flinch first, the watch holds longer, and the escalation ladder between the two thresholds IS the triangle's present-side cascade.
